offerings.name: Search — Free Plan
offerings.free_quota: 1,000 credits every month, refreshed monthly, no credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选抓取全文
offerings.note: Search costs 2 credits per 10 results，按每10条向上取整；Highlights默认开启。

offerings.name: Search — Hobby
offerings.pricing: $16/month billed yearly for 5,000 credits per month (2,500 searches); 1,000 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Hobby年付月均价，含2,500次搜索/月
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选抓取全文
offerings.note: 月付为$19/月；PAYG为$5/1,000 credits，即500次最多10条结果的搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Standard
offerings.pricing: $83/month billed yearly for 100,000 credits per month (50,000 searches); 2,000 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Standard年付月均价，含50,000次搜索/月
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选抓取全文
offerings.note: PAYG为$5/2,000 credits，即1,000次最多10条结果的搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Growth
offerings.pricing: $333/month billed yearly for 500,000 credits per month (250,000 searches); 2,500 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Growth年付月均价，含250,000次搜索/月
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选抓取全文
offerings.note: PAYG为$5/2,500 credits，即1,250次最多10条结果的搜索。

offerings.name: Search — Scale
offerings.pricing: $599/monthly billed yearly for 1,000,000 credits per month (500,000 searches); 5,000 extra credits per $5
offerings.price_basis: Scale年付月均价，含500,000次搜索/月
offerings.output_type: 结构化网页、新闻和图片搜索结果，含标题、描述、URL；可选抓取全文
offerings.note: PAYG为$5/5,000 credits，即2,500次最多10条结果的搜索。

offerings.name: End-to-End ZDR Search
offerings.pricing: 10 credits per 10 results; available on Enterprise plans
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；查询和结果数据在整个流程中均不存储
offerings.note: Firecrawl及上游搜索提供商均执行零数据保留；Enterprise价格为Custom。

offerings.name: Anonymized ZDR Search
offerings.pricing: 2 credits per 10 results; available on Enterprise plans
offerings.output_type: 结构化搜索结果；Firecrawl不保留数据，向上游发送匿名查询
offerings.note: 上游搜索提供商可能缓存查询，但查询不附带识别信息；Enterprise价格为Custom。
